description:
Toggle the authenticated user's favorite (shown to them as "follow") on
a creator, creation, place, or event, or on an event list (event_zone) /
the new-arrivals list of creations (creation_zone). Requires a Bearer
token (a User API token, or an OAuth token with the favorites:write
scope). Act only when the user asked to.

It flips the current state: not favorited becomes favorited, favorited
becomes not favorited. There is no separate add / remove, so do not
call it twice to "make sure" — the second call undoes the first. Read
the result to learn the state you ended in; for lists you can check
beforehand with list_followable_zones (`following`).

Effects: favoriting a creator, creation, place or event adds it to what
the user follows on Zindies. Following a list also subscribes the user
to notifications of new entries in it. To attend an event use
rsvp_event, which favorites the event by itself.

Returns `favorited` (true / false: the state after this call) and
`target`, the record acted on: `type`, `id`, `token` (null for events)
and `name` for a creator / creation / place / event; `type`, `id`,
`slug`, `name`, `kind`, `area` and `url` for a list.

Errors come back as an error result (`isError: true`) with `error`:
"unauthorized" (no or invalid token), "insufficient_scope", or
"not_found" — an unknown or non-public token, an event not yet
announced, or a list slug that is malformed or names an unknown kind /
area. Nothing changes on error.

locale.description: Response language for translatable text fields (names, titles, descriptions): ja = Japanese, en = English, ko = Korean, zh-TW = Traditional Chinese. Pass the language the user is conversing in when it is one of these; otherwise omit it. Fields without a translation fall back to their source language (usually Japanese), so one response can mix languages. Tokens, ids, dates and URLs are the same in every locale. Default: ja.

target_type.description: What `token` refers to: `creator`, `creation`, `place` or `event` for a single record; `event_zone` for an event list (the page /events/<kind>/<area>); `creation_zone` for the new-arrivals list (/creations). Use the `type` value from a `zone` / `zones` entry or list_followable_zones as-is.

token.description: Identifier of the target; its form depends on `target_type`. creator / creation / place: the public `token` (short lowercase string, e.g. "fqpi"). event: the numeric event id as a string (e.g. "1234"). event_zone: the slug "<kind>/<area>", where kind is "all", an event kind (e.g. "book_club") or "period_event", and area is "all" (nationwide) or a region slug — e.g. "all/all" = every event nationwide, "all/kanto" = every event in Kanto, "book_club/all" = book clubs nationwide. A wider list covers narrower ones, so do not follow a region on top of "all/all". creation_zone: always "all/all". Take slugs from the `slug` field of list_followable_zones or of a `zone` / `zones` entry rather than composing them.

name: toggle_favorite
